instruction: Look at task-012_initial.scad. Change the model into a multi-stage hollow nozzle. The total height must be 42 mm. Make a lower cylindrical collar from z=0 to z=10 with outside diameter 32 mm, a tapered middle section from z=10 to z=28 that reduces from outside diameter 32 mm to 20 mm, an upper neck from z=28 to z=38 with outside diameter 20 mm, and an outlet chamfer from z=38 to z=42 that reduces from outside diameter 20 mm to 16 mm. The internal bore must be diameter 18 mm from z=0 to z=12, diameter 10 mm from z=12 to z=38, then taper from diameter 10 mm to diameter 6 mm at the outlet. Add one diameter 3 mm cross hole through the side wall along the X axis, centered at y=0 and z=18. Fully render and export /home/user/Desktop/task-012_output.stl.
